name: Langkawi
subject: the Langkawi Sky Bridge curving over jungle-covered mountain peaks, with a sea eagle gliding
composition: the curved sky bridge sweeping across the middle, peaks below, the eagle above
placement: curved around the circle between two concentric border lines, like a classic round passport stamp: LANGKAWI along the top arc and MALAYSIA along the bottom arc

name: Kyoto
subject: a tunnel of Fushimi Inari torii gates leading up a stone path
composition: the torii gates receding in strong perspective toward the centre
placement: in a solid straight header bar across the top of the square, the letters reversed out (paper colour) inside the inked bar, like a ticket label

name: Hong Kong
subject: a Hong Kong double-decker tram on a busy street with neon-style signboards, and a red-sail junk boat in the harbour behind
composition: the tram large in the foreground, the harbour and junk boat in the background
placement: painted on the side panel of the tram as part of the scene (not in a banner); all the other signboards stay blank

name: Taipei
subject: Taipei 101 tower rising above a night-market street hung with round lanterns
composition: the tower tall on the right, the lantern street in the lower left
placement: set vertically down the left edge, one letter under another (stacked, upright letters), inside a narrow vertical strip of the border

name: Bali
subject: Balinese rice terraces, palm trees and a split temple gate
composition: the scene fills the oval behind the lettering
placement: BALI as very large bold block letters across the middle like a vintage 'greetings from' postcard, with the scene visible behind and inside the letters; INDONESIA small underneath

name: Singapore
subject: the Merlion fountain with Marina Bay Sands and the Supertrees behind
composition: the Merlion on the left spouting water, the skyline across the back
placement: on a small luggage tag hanging from the lower right corner of the octagon by a little loop of string, the tag drawn in the same ink
